page.content:
Alberta Bazaar (Born 1977) is the daughter of Walter Bazaar and Pomona Krupp and the sister of Hazel and Violet Bazaar. Her fourth cousins are Bart, Lisa and Maggie. Her third cousin once removed is Homer.

page.overview:
Who is Alberta Bazaar?

Alberta Bazaar (Born 1977) is the daughter of Walter Bazaar and Pomona Krupp and the sister of Hazel and Violet Bazaar. Her fourth cousins are Bart, Lisa and Maggie. Her third cousin once removed is Homer.
